description: Image Description: The image features a small suitcase with a handle on top, positioned against a brick wall. The suitcase has a design on the front depicting three animated princess-like figures in elegant dresses. The artwork is detailed, showing the flowing gowns and distinct hairstyles of the characters. Below the characters, there is text that reads "Princess Boutique," accompanied by decorative floral elements. The image has a sepia tone, giving it a vintage or nostalgic feel. The ground is concrete, with some small debris visible
